history.summary: IMPORTANT IDENTITY NOTE: No published travel, tourism, temple, or map source documents a temple named 'Thoubal Wangmataba Temple'; the identity, exact location, deity, age, and history of this shrine could not be verified from web sources, so this entry is provisional (verify). 'Wangmataba' is a locality on the Indo-Myanmar Road in Thoubal district, Manipur (PIN 795138), which appears in news reports for a December 2012 incident but not for any temple. The documented historic temple of Thoubal district is the Thangal General Temple honouring the Manipurese folk hero and soldier Thangal General (per Zee Zest), which is not at Wangmataba; other Thoubal listings are small community mandirs (ISKCON Thoubal, Radha Krishna Mandir) and traditional laisangs. Do not conflate this entry with the Thangal General Temple. Coordinates are the Thoubal town centroid (verify).

name: Thoubal Wangmataba Temple
town_description: Thoubal is the headquarters town of Thoubal district, Manipur, about 22 km southeast of Imphal on the Indo-Myanmar Road (NH-102). The district is known for the Khongjom War Memorial (Anglo-Manipur War, 1891), Waithou Lake, and the Thangal General Temple honouring the Manipurese folk hero. Wangmataba is a locality on the town's outskirts toward Haokha (PIN 795138).
